assets.title: Ящики и короба
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent game-prop reference sheet for modular merchandise to fill a wooden merchant stall, for later image-to-3D conversion.
Primary request: One sheet containing exactly FOUR distinct merchandise props or compact self-contained prop groups, arranged in a spacious two-by-two layout. These are goods only. No shop, canopy, shelf, counter or display furniture. Each unit is clearly isolated from the others with broad fully transparent gaps, no overlap or touching between units, so each can be used independently. Do not duplicate the same object in different views.
Art direction: Match our chosen rustic merchant stall with an arched olive canvas canopy: chunky hand-painted stylized 3D fantasy game props, round-edged broad simple forms, worn warm brown and ochre timber, muted olive cloth, oatmeal burlap, earthy terracotta and subdued brown leather, plain dull iron hardware. Moderate geometry detail, broad painted material definition, restrained wear. Lived-in travelling trade in a forest camp. No photorealism, no tiny noisy detail, no thick black comic outlines, no bright cartoon colours.
Camera/framing: Every object in the same elevated front three-quarter view, about 25 degrees above horizontal, with modest orthographic-like perspective. Show the complete silhouette and all feet/base edges. Roughly consistent believable relative sizes, with useful space between objects and safe margins around the sheet. Each of the four units has substantial image area and is easy to crop independently. High-resolution square sheet.
Materials and construction: robust simple volumes, readable seams, believable joints, broad bevels. Wrapping and handles have visible thickness. No strings so thin they become floating lines; no hanging ornaments. Each object or compact group has a flat usable base for placing on a shelf or counter. No pedestal.
Lighting: unlit-style diffuse/albedo appearance, neutral even visibility with very gentle form shading only. No directional light, sunset colour cast, bright specular highlights, baked cast shadows, ground shadows, lighting equipment, glow or light-source props.
Background: genuine fully transparent alpha, including gaps inside handles and between objects. No opaque background, checkerboard pattern, gradient, horizon, ground plane, floor, rug or environment.
Absolutely exclude: any text, captions, numerals, labels, grid lines, frames, measurements, watermarks, logos, emblems, runes, crests, heraldry, flags, banners, signs, people, animals, weapons, lamps, candles, fire, smoke, vegetation, coins scattered as tiny particles, tiny contents or dense clutter.
Produce the merchandise described below only.

Four merchandise units: TOP LEFT a medium closed square timber shipping crate with a broad diagonal wooden brace, around 55 cm wide, thick worn planks and simple dull iron corner straps; TOP RIGHT a low wide closed rectangular wooden storage box, around 65 cm wide, broad plank lid and two plain iron bands, no lock ornament; BOTTOM LEFT a compact stack of two differently sized closed wooden crates, naturally resting one on the other as one self-contained group, clearly distinguishable edges; BOTTOM RIGHT a shallow open wooden goods box, around 45 cm wide, containing exactly three large tied cloth parcels clearly readable above its rim. The open box must not hide dozens of tiny objects. All wood matches the warm weathered wood of the olive-canopy stall. No treasure chest fantasy ornament.
